theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H], ∃ c : (Rep.res H.subtype A).ρ.invariants →ₗ[k] A.ρ.invariants, (∀ v : A, c ((Rep.res H.subtype A).ρ.normToInvariants v) = A.ρ.normToInvariants v) ∧ ∀ (a : A.ρ.invariants) (b : (Rep.res H.subtype A).ρ.invariants), (b : A) = (a : A) → c b = H.index • a
theorems.natural_summary: Sum translates over representatives of left cosets. Subgroup invariance makes each summand independent of its representative; left multiplication permutes cosets, making the linear sum ambient-invariant. The bijection (G/H) × H → G identifies transfer of the subgroup norm with the ambient norm. On ambient-invariant vectors every summand equals the original vector, giving repeated addition by H.index.
